LocusSetup: Put your Incarna ({incarna-custom1}) in a land with your {presence}.Replaces Innate Power: SERPENT WAKES IN POWERAdds Special Rule and Growth option.Locus of the Serpent's RegardSpirits with absorbed {presence} can use your {presence} at {incarna-custom1} for targeting. {incarna-custom1} doesn't count towards your Deep Slumber limit. Growth (Always): After a Spirit uses a land-targeting Power Card, they may Repeat it at {incarna-custom1} by paying its cost. (Max. 1 Power Card per turn for each of their absorbed {presence}.) You may help pay some or all of this cost. (These Repeats ignore Range and target requirements.)Add 1 {presence} at {incarna-custom1}. If a Spirit has 2 or more absorbed {presence}, you may instead Add 1 {presence} in one of their lands without {blight}.
